verdict.rationale: Cline's docs describe Skills as modular instruction sets that extend the agent for specific tasks. Each skill packages guidance, processes and optional resources, and Cline loads it only when relevant, which directly matches the story. MCP servers and plugins offer further ways to extend the agent. missing for 10: documentation of how developers author and install their own custom skills (format and locations), and independent or hands-on corroboration that skills work as described.
